title: Quest Foglight for Databases loadManageServerLicense Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution… (CVE-2026-92194)
description: CVE-2026-92194 is a high-severity vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases involving a directory traversal flaw in the loadManageServerLicense script. This flaw allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges by exploiting improper validation of user-supplied paths in file operations.
